title: DebatePolicy
description: Policy governing debate behavior and budget limits in the CCSR protocol.

max_rounds.description: Maximum number of debate rounds allowed.

escalation_threshold.description: Score threshold below which claims are escalated for review.

judge_confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence required from the judge to accept a claim.

max_tokens.description: Maximum total tokens allowed for the run.

max_model_calls.description: Maximum number of model API calls allowed.

budget.description: Resource budget limits for the run.

drift_detection_enabled.description: Whether topic drift detection is enabled.

auto_stop_enabled.description: Whether automatic stopping on convergence is enabled.
